items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: Black Benny's funeral was the biggest funeral of all of them.

ctx.x: Okay, we got everybody's name down. See, we're going to talk some more about the funerals that they, that they had like ones where they made pictures. You said they made pictures? They made moving pictures of your brother?
Moving pictures of my brother and also of Black Benny. Uh huh. Yeah.
Did they take the sound trucks with them and microphones and everything? No, no, no.

items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-04-07
items.q: When me and Black Benny was... I mean me and Ray and Happy, they was the grand march.

ctx.x: They made a moving picture of the big Jack, the big... Yeah, my brother was coming out today.
Made a picture of Black Benny. Made a picture of his funeral.
